text: {"memo": "COSTCO WHOLESALE CORP – FY2024 Highlights: Revenue $254.45\u202fbn, net income $7.37\u202fbn, operating income $9.29\u202fbn, diluted EPS $16.56, operating cash flow $11.34\u202fbn. Compared with FY2023 (Revenue $242.29\u202fbn, net income $6.29\u202fbn, operating income $8.11\u202fbn, diluted EPS $14.16, operating cash flow $11.07\u202fbn), the company delivered roughly 5% revenue growth, net income up ~17%, and operating income up ~15%. Operating margin improved modestly to about 3.6% from 3.3%, while net profit margin rose to roughly 2.9% from 2.6%. EPS increased to $16.56 from $14.16, reflecting strong profitability. Operating cash flow remained robust, edging higher to $11.34\u202fbn from $11.07\u202fbn. The consistent top\u2011line expansion and margin improvement support a solid earnings trajectory. View: BUY \u2013 strong fundamentals and cash generation."}
